name: Lumina Presence
description: Cognitive presence layer — passive observer of OpenClaw runtime state. Phase 1: no actions, no narration, no initiative; only state tracking and a status tool. Higher phases build on this foundation.

enabled.description: Enable or disable the Lumina Presence layer.

stateTransitionLogLevel.description: How much detail to log when presence state changes. 'off' = silent, 'summary' = one line per transition, 'verbose' = include event payload. Default: summary.

idleTimeoutMs.description: Milliseconds without activity before presence transitions back to Idle. Default 60_000 (1 minute).

enabled.description: Allow Lumina to schedule tightly controlled proactive updates.

defaultSessionKey.description: Fallback session for proactive updates when no recent session is known.
